family_definition: Each unchanged source bore band may independently choose any real pressure half-angle beta in the closed interval [30,90] degrees. Its radial pressure is uniform along its recorded axial interval and proportional to max(cos(pi*phi/(2*beta)),0) inside |phi|<=beta, with phi measured from its own signed lateral force direction.

Normalize each pressure exactly to its own saved band force using J(beta)=integral[-beta,beta] cos(pi*phi/(2*beta))*cos(phi) dphi. Exact stored binary source forces, radii and axial endpoints are retained. No stored rounded endpoint amplitude is asserted to equal its irrational exact normalization.

The two bands at each bore retain their own source axial centers, resultants and complete source-wrench reconstruction. Every other cleat action remains present, with no new support or balancing force. One finite-area contradiction at the selected band suffices to rule out the full C16 stress-domain criterion for the complete prescribed-load cleat.

For each window [beta0,beta1], the zero-extended nonnegative angular shape increases pointwise with beta, and cos(phi)>=0 on [-pi/2,pi/2], so J(beta)<=J(beta1). Thus pressure(beta,phi)>=|F|*shape(beta0,phi)/(radius*length*J(beta1)) over any witness strictly inside beta0. Three windows cover every real beta in [30,90] degrees.

J(30)=3*sqrt(3)/8, J(45)=2*sqrt(2)/3, J(60)=6/5 and J(90)=pi/2. The corresponding lower-end shapes are 4*c^3-3*c, 2*c^2-1 and sqrt((1+4*c^3-3*c)/2), where c=cos(phi)>cos(beta0). Existing exact square-root, pi, normal-chart and full-tensor support helpers are reused.
limits: The pressure family and positive-linear C16 stress domain are unobserved engineering hypotheses, not calibrated material/contact laws, an NDS bearing allowable or a complete fracture model. All retained strength divisors, load factors and physical applicability limits remain unchanged.

Three previously saved witness arcs only choose candidates. Exact rational pressure lower, complete stress-domain support upper and positive-area inequalities decide the continuous-angle certificate. A lower at or below one is inconclusive; no optimum, safety pass or absence of other witnesses follows.

A necessary boundary failure precludes every complete stress field that retains this same boundary traction and stress domain. Additional interior equilibrium, axial/shear/torque or brittle constraints cannot restore that declared combination. This is conditional negative qualification, not a measured physical failure, a physical demand bound or complete resistance of a different load/constitutive model.

Use one common source band to cover every half-angle window; independent half-angle choices at other bands therefore cannot remove the contradiction. Other angular shapes, axial pressure profiles, force distributions or material laws are outside this family and receive no failure/pass transfer.

Preserve the full active engineering goal and all broader physical applicability limits. Keep the reviewed geometry, 100 bolts, 66 Hillman axes, rejected cross-tie history, panel/screw deferral and excluded actual fit. No native, elastic, frame, contact-equilibrium or CAD solve, design change, observation or release occurs.
